text:
Gold Price in 2016
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2016, the LBMA gold price rose 3.1% between 2016-01-29 ($1,112) and 2016-12-29 ($1,146). The highest sampled price was $1,342 in July and the lowest was $1,112 in January. The mean of these observations was $1,248. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
